notes.title: 1.5 Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

[previewyoutube=c9W2fJGIvew;full][/previewyoutube]

Today, Lucid Nina is officially at version 1.5, which means:


 Updated visuals (optional);
 Better texts (thanks to Wavelenght, a great friend of mine and also an amazing writer for proofreading the biggest texts in the game).
 Bugfixes (thanks to Wavelenght again! And to other players who helped me reporting the bugs).
 A demo version, which will be available on Steam in a couple of weeks.


I believe this will be the final update of Lucid Nina. I hope you enjoy the story we wanted to tell with the game. Hopefully this will be the first of many stories that we expect to bring to you!

Thank you very much!

slimelvl2
